Class SignRequest

java.lang.Object
se.oidc.nimbus.signrequest.SignRequest
public class SignRequest extends Object
Representation of the Signature Request Parameter as defined in section 3.1 of Signature Extension for OpenID Connect, version 1.2.

For a signature request (scope https://id.oidc.se/scope/sign) the tbs_data field must be present. For a signature approval request (scope https://id.oidc.se/scope/signApproval without the sign scope) it must not be present. Since the scope is not part of the parameter value, it is up to the caller to check this.

When the parameter is passed as a custom request parameter, its value is a signed JWT. See SignRequestClaimsSet.

Author:
Martin Lindström
